title: Exact-pullback derived module adjunction
statement: For a commutative condensed ring Lambda and any scheme morphism j:V→T, take the recorded total derived adjunction Lj^* ⊣ Rj_*. Define punctureDerivedAdjunction by transport of its left adjoint along the canonical isomorphism from left-derived inverse image to exact termwise inverse image. Thus its actual unit and counit are those of the recorded derived adjunction under that fixed comparison; it assumes no puncture-invariance theorem Built from [def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull-adjunction], [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull], [sk-def-sfb-module-objects].
